seeds.title: Rain, paved ground and drainage
seeds.summary: Predict which catchment will flood, then change rainfall, paved ground and drainage on a simple runoff model.
seeds.subject: humanities
seeds.learningObjective: Explain how rainfall intensity, impermeable cover and drainage capacity affect surface-water accumulation.
seeds.descriptor: A live runoff model with three controls, calculated readouts and an inline one-hour graph.

seeds.title: Which lining keeps water cool?
seeds.summary: Plan a fair test of bottle linings: classify variables, spot a confound, then put the method in order.
seeds.subject: science
seeds.learningObjective: Identify what is changed, measured and kept the same, then improve a method to test one factor fairly.
seeds.descriptor: A bottle-lining fair-test planner: classify variables, diagnose a confound, then reorder the method.

seeds.title: Conductor or insulator?
seeds.summary: Sort classroom objects into conductors and insulators. A wrong bin costs a life and explains why.
seeds.subject: science
seeds.learningObjective: Classify materials as electrical conductors or insulators and explain the difference.
seeds.descriptor: A 60-second sorting game: tap an object, choose a bin, lose a life with an explanation when wrong.

seeds.title: Cut extra words
seeds.summary: Edit a school canteen rule by removing waffle while keeping its action, place, timing and reason.
seeds.subject: english
seeds.learningObjective: Edit a paragraph for concision without removing the facts needed to understand its rule and reason.
seeds.descriptor: A single tappable paragraph with a live word count and feedback about load-bearing facts.

seeds.title: Rectangles with the same perimeter
seeds.summary: Change width on a fixed perimeter, watch the rectangle and area, and find which pair is largest.
seeds.subject: mathematics
seeds.learningObjective: Generate rectangles with the same perimeter and explain why area is largest near a square.
seeds.descriptor: A live rectangle and pair graph showing that a fixed perimeter does not fix the area.

seeds.title: Equivalent fractions
seeds.summary: Split and shade two bars, then check why equivalent fractions name the same amount.
seeds.subject: mathematics
seeds.learningObjective: Recognise equivalent fractions and explain why the same operation on both parts preserves value.
seeds.descriptor: Two split-and-shade bars plus three misconception checks with specific feedback.

seeds.title: What do m and c do?
seeds.summary: Change gradient and intercept one at a time and watch y = mx + c on the graph.
seeds.subject: mathematics
seeds.learningObjective: Explain how gradient and vertical intercept affect a straight-line graph.
seeds.descriptor: Two coefficient sliders update equation, point value and inline SVG graph together.

seeds.title: Line golf
seeds.summary: Change m and c so y = mx + c passes through every flag in as few strokes as possible.
seeds.subject: mathematics
seeds.learningObjective: Choose gradient and intercept so a straight line passes through given points.
seeds.descriptor: Three golf holes: sliders for m and c, live graph, flag targets and a par for each hole.

seeds.title: Observation or interpretation?
seeds.summary: Sort what you saw from what you guessed, then choose evidence that could test a cooling claim.
seeds.subject: humanities
seeds.learningObjective: Distinguish observation from interpretation and identify evidence needed to support a geographical claim.
seeds.descriptor: A compact field notebook combining classification, corroboration and conclusion ordering.

seeds.title: Mean and median
seeds.summary: Drag a score on a dot plot and see why one extreme value pulls the mean more than the median.
seeds.subject: mathematics
seeds.learningObjective: Compare how an extreme score affects the mean and median and explain the difference.
seeds.descriptor: A touch-first dot plot where moving scores changes mean and median markers live.

seeds.title: How rain forms
seeds.summary: Label each sentence’s job, then put an explanation of rain into a clear order.
seeds.subject: english
seeds.learningObjective: Organise an explanation using a topic sentence, ordered details and concluding link.
seeds.descriptor: A two-step paragraph builder preserving sentence roles and temporal logic.

seeds.title: How this text tries to persuade
seeds.summary: Find inclusive language, a hard fact and a rhetorical question, then say what each does to the reader.
seeds.subject: english
seeds.learningObjective: Explain how evidence, rhetorical questions and inclusive language shape a reader's response.
seeds.descriptor: A highlighted source appeal followed by three technique-to-effect checks.

seeds.title: Parts of a plant cell
seeds.summary: Tap five cell parts, then match each structure to what it does.
seeds.subject: science
seeds.learningObjective: Identify major plant-cell structures and explain how each contributes to cell function.
seeds.descriptor: A CSS-drawn plant cell with tap-to-name reveals and a structure-to-function match.

seeds.title: Can we trust this source?
seeds.summary: Judge a campaign leaflet by purpose, then choose evidence that could check the claim.
seeds.subject: humanities
seeds.learningObjective: Evaluate source usefulness and reliability using producer, purpose and corroborating evidence.
seeds.descriptor: A source card followed by purpose, evidence and historical-vocabulary checks.

seeds.title: Spell it before the sun sets
seeds.summary: Guess letters in a word. Each wrong letter adds a sun ray and explains a spelling pattern.
seeds.subject: english
seeds.learningObjective: Spell high-frequency words with silent letters and common letter patterns.
seeds.descriptor: A hangman-style spelling game: six rays, letter keys, and a teaching note on every miss.

seeds.title: Times-tables lightning
seeds.summary: Answer 6, 7, 8 and 9 times-table facts in 60 seconds. Misses break the streak and return at the end.
seeds.subject: mathematics
seeds.learningObjective: Recall multiplication facts from the 6, 7, 8 and 9 times tables fluently.
seeds.descriptor: A 60-second times-tables game with four answers, a streak counter and a missed-fact review.

seeds.title: Share the town budget
seeds.summary: Split a fixed town-council budget and inspect the service trade-offs created by each mix.
seeds.subject: civics
seeds.learningObjective: Explain how allocating a fixed public budget creates trade-offs between service outcomes.
seeds.descriptor: A fixed $100,000 town-council allocation with linked service meters and a trade-off check.

seeds.title: Where does the shadow fall?
seeds.summary: Predict a shadow's direction and length, then drag a lamp to test the straight-line light model.
seeds.subject: science
seeds.learningObjective: Predict and explain how a lamp's position changes a shadow's direction and length.
seeds.descriptor: A draggable lamp and fixed object in SVG with live shadow direction and length.
